1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Astronomical Book (1 Enoch 72-82) (c. 250 BC)

'Her circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and her chariot in which she ascends is driven by the wind' — the moon's variable phases governed by wind-driven chariot machinery. Tewahedo monastic natural-philosophy (preserved in the Mashafa Falasfa, the 'Book of the Philosophers') retains this image of celestial bodies as carried by winds — a pre-Aristotelian physics that the Tewahedo tradition preserved while Western scholasticism shifted to the Aristotelian-Ptolemaic crystalline spheres.
